title.narrative: Financing Program for Investment and Risk Management in Gas and Clean Energy Pro
Programa Financiero para la Inversin y Gestin de Riesgos en Proyectos de Gas y

description.narrative: El objetivo del programa es incrementar la inversin privada en infraestructura de gas y de generacin a partir de Energa Limpia (EL) para contribuir a elevar la eficiencia del sistema energtico reduciendo las emisiones de Gases de Efecto Invernadero (GEI) en Mxico. Para ello, el programa proveer instrumentos financieros adaptados a las necesidades de esta tipologa de proyectos, canalizando recursos a travs de la Banca Pblica de Desarrollo (BPD).

The programs objective is to increase private investment in gas and clean power generation infrastructure projects so as to help boost the efficiency of the energy sector and reduce greenhouse gas emissions in Mexico. To this end, the program will offer financial instruments tailored to the needs of projects of this kind, channeling resources through the public development banking system.
